rootCause: Missing entries adopted constructor IDs without reserving identities of retained entries visited later. Both mapped to the same key and Object.fromEntries overwrote the missing repetition. A missing parent could also match the retained parent's ID and steal its descendant associations. Sparse validation permits the incomplete output.
fix: Reserve current design, occurrence and port identities plus fresh connection identities before mapping. Allocate missing occurrence/port IDs with a deterministic collision-checked suffix, registering every allocation. Retained associations keep their IDs unchanged. A newly allocated parent cannot equal any persisted occurrence ID, so only genuinely retained lineage can match descendants. No opaque ID parsing, gap preservation, or rejection workaround.
